Class ShamanicRitualEffect

java.lang.Object
mesos.effects.BuildingEffect
mesos.effects.ShamanicRitualEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ShamanicRitualEffect extends BuildingEffect
Building effect that modifies the player's shamanic ritual outcome: may add extra shaman icons, ignore the minority penalty, or double the majority reward.
